Standalone desktop downloads with Electron included. No Node.js, Python, or system Electron installation is required.

- **Windows x64:** Download the `.zip`, extract everything, and open **Dorf Drone Forge.exe**. The build is unsigned; Windows may ask for confirmation.
- **Linux x64:** Download the `.tar.gz`, extract everything, and run `./dorf-drone-forge` from the extracted folder. Requires a Linux desktop with Electron-compatible system libraries and Chromium sandbox support.

Keep each extracted folder intact. Audio works offline. Use **MIDI setup** to connect a controller; press Escape to silence audio. Sound presets and MIDI mapping backups are separate exports.

SHA256 checksums are included. Both packaged builds are smoke-tested before publishing; physical USB MIDI hardware still requires a local test.
